target.statement: OmniVerifier-7B achieves 0.653 overall rule-based accuracy on ViVerBench, an +8.3 improvement over Qwen2.5-VL-7B (0.570).

compute.basis: The headline +8.3 requires RL training Qwen2.5-VL-7B on 28k constructed visual-verification data for 100 steps on 64 A100-80G GPUs, and the paper links no training/eval code or data for this target.

blockers: No paper code release (only a FLUX dependency link)
Needs 64 A100-80G GPUs for the 100-step RL training used by OmniVerifier-7B
ViVerBench and the 28k visual-verification training data are not linked or confirmed downloadable
Closed-source APIs (GPT-5, Seedream 3.0) are used in data construction
Requires 7B VLM RL training/inference, not feasible on an 8 CPU/16 GB laptop
title: Generative Universal Verifier as Multimodal Meta-Reasoner
